appStore.name: Choreia
appStore.subtitle: Hip-hop dance practice
appStore.promotionalText: Camera-tracked hip-hop practice. The Bounce counts your repetitions and shows exactly what it measured against three real teachers — no score yet, and we say why.

playStore.shortDescription: Camera-tracked hip-hop practice — reps counted, not scored, and honest why.

description:
Choreia watches you practice hip-hop, one step at a time, and measures what it can actually measure — nothing more.

INTERACTIVE TODAY
The Bounce is a live, camera-tracked practice session. Choreia counts your repetitions and shows the specific joint measurements from each one, compared against three real teachers' footage. It does not turn that into a single score.

WHY NO SCORE
We measured three teachers doing the Bounce, and the result surprised us: they move so alike that the differences between them are smaller than what a phone camera can reliably resolve. A score here would mostly be measuring our own uncertainty, not your bounce — so you get the step, the count, and three teachers' versions of it, and the number is the part we are leaving out on purpose.

SHOWN, NOT YET INTERACTIVE
The Running Man, Groove, and Roger Rabbit are reference pages built from real teachers' footage, each with its own specific reason it isn't a live lesson yet — a foot-timing measurement a single phone camera cannot resolve reliably, or teachers who disagree about which way the step faces. The Rock is written down but not yet measured against any teacher, so it stays locked rather than graded against our own notes.

What we measure, we report plainly, and what we cannot honestly measure, we say so instead of guessing.

Your camera view is never shown back to you and never leaves your device — Choreia reads only the positions of your joints, frame by frame, and no video is recorded, stored, or uploaded, on this device or anywhere else. A short summary of each practice session is kept on this device so you can see what you did; uninstalling the app removes it.

This is a dance practice tool. It does not diagnose anything and nothing it shows is medical or treatment advice.

One honestly measured step today. More are being built, in the open, one teacher-verified movement at a time.
$measurementDisclosureLine: hip_hop_foundations/style.json'un honesty blogu bu stilde HICBIR SEYIN 'measured' olmadigini soyluyor (measured: [] — 'bu stil bugun hicbir sey puanlamiyor'). Ama bu, hicbir olcum yapilmadigi anlamina gelmiyor: Bounce lesson'i CANLI olcum URETIYOR (judge.dart'in kneeDeltaDeg/identityWorstJointDeg gibi olcum anahtarlari, live_view.dart'taki 'What we measured' karti) — yalniz bunlari TEK bir SKORA indirgemiyor. 'Measured ama graded degil' ayrimini description'a tasidim (Ostinato'nun 'reported plainly, not a fake precise number' deseniyle ayni sinif), stilin kendi honesty blogunun 'measured:[]' cumlesini 'hicbir sey olculmuyor' diye YANLIS okumadan.
$onlyOneStartableLessonWhy: 🔴 EN KRITIK BULGU, KAYDA GECMESI GEREKEN: hip_hop_foundations'in 7 dersinden yalniz BIRI (`hh_l1_bounce`) gercekten baslatilabilir. `library_catalog.dart:476` (`_offer`): `l.stepId == null` -> `LessonBlock.noLessonBuilt`, baslatilamaz. style.json'da `step` alani yalniz `hh_l1_bounce`de dolu (`hh_bounce`); `hh_l1_running_man`/`hh_l1_groove`/`hh_l1_roger_rabbit` HICBIRINDE `step` alani YOK (null) — yani bunlar demoOnly:true olsalar bile kamera ekranina HIC ULASMIYOR, yalniz bilgilendirici sayfa. `hh_l1_rock` zaten `status:locked`. Iki drill (`hh_bounce_slow`/`hh_bounce_wall`) de `step` tasimiyor. SONUC: bugun sevk edilirse, Choreia'nin TUM etkilesimli/kamera-canli deneyimi TEK bir dersten (Bounce, demo-only) ibarettir — description bunu 'INTERACTIVE TODAY' basligi ile TEK dersle sinirlayarak yansitti, digerlerini 'SHOWN, NOT YET INTERACTIVE' diye ayirdi. Bu ayrimi yapmadan yazsaydim (butun demoOnly derslerin kamerayla etkilesimli oldugunu ima etseydim) JabLab'in tempo-hatasiyla AYNI SINIF bir asiri-iddia olurdu.
$salsaExcludedWhy: 🔴 IKINCI KRITIK BULGU: salsa_shines HIC ACILAMIYOR, description'a HIC GIRMEDI. `content/library.json` satir ~150: `status:"live"` (icerik gercekligi — `ss_l1_footwork` GERCEKTEN puanli, 8 bacak-eklemi 1.57-5.76deg, hangi ayagin onde oldugu 15.6deg marj) AMA `style.json`nin `shipGates`i `bpmResolved:blocked=true` tasiyor (bpmStatus DISPUTED, iki olcum ~2x farkli: 89-100 vs 160-220 BPM) VE `style_availability.dart`in kendi yorumu bunu adiyla soyluyor: 'A style can honestly be live... and still be unopenable (salsa_shines today: BPM disputed)' — `shipGatesNote`: 'bu stil BPM cozulmeden yayina cikmaz, statu live olsa da'. Yani salsa'nin puanli dersi VAR ama KULLANICI ONA HIC ULASAMIYOR — description'da salsa'dan HIC bahsetmedim (JabLab'in 'olculuyor ama gosterilmiyor' hatasinin ayna-goruntusu olurdu: bu kez 'puanli ama ULASILAMAZ'i puanli-ve-mevcut gibi yazmak). Tek referans: kapanis paragrafinda 'more are being built' — isim verilmeden.
$noCameraPreviewWhy: Choreia'nin kendi `lib/`inde VE pinli `motion_camera` paketinde (`packages/motion_camera/lib/`, f13bdc93 pini) SIFIR `CameraPreview`/`CustomPainter`/iskelet-cizim widget'i var — grep dogrulandi. `live_view.dart` yalniz METIN/SAYAC gosteriyor ('Watching. Keep going...', 'N read so far', sonra 'What we measured'/'What we are NOT checking'/'What we noticed' kartlari) — kullaniciya kendi goruntusu veya bir iskelet-bindirmesi HIC gosterilmiyor. Bu yuzden description'da 'watch yourself' / 'see your skeleton' turu bir cumle YOK — Info.plist'in kendi metni de zaten 'we only read the positions of your joints' diyor, bir GORUNTU vaadi tasimiyor; description bunu ayniyla korudu, fazlasini eklemedi.

cameraPermissionRationale.ios: Choreia watches your dancing to give you feedback on your steps. Video never leaves your phone — we only read the positions of your joints, and no video is recorded or uploaded.
cameraPermissionRationale.$source: ios/Runner/Info.plist NSCameraUsageDescription — BURAYA KOPYALANDI, DEGISTIRILMEDI. 'Feedback' kelimesi bir SKOR/VERDICT vaat etmiyor (Bounce zaten skorsuz) — Live ekranindaki olcum kartlariyla ('What we measured') tutarli, bir gorsel-bindirme vaadi TASIMIYOR (bkz $noCameraPreviewWhy).

rationale: Realistic or cartoon violence: NONE — dans pratigi, dovus/rekabet mekanigi yok
Contests / competitive play against others: NONE — cok-oyunculu, siralama, sosyal ozellik yok

Medical/treatment information: NONE — aile sozlesmesi kurali (motion-core/lib/docs/00-AILE-MIMARISI.md:56, 'wellness dili, tibbi iddia sifir, aile geneli') KAYNAK; Choreia'nin kendi lib'inde bu diskaimeri dogrulayan bir ekran-metni YOK (Ostinato'nun aksine) — description'daki 'does not diagnose anything' cumlesi kod-dogrulanmis bir iddia degil, aile kuralinin dogrudan uygulanmasi, adiyla ayirt edildi
Unrestricted web access: NONE — grep dogrulandi, webview_flutter/url_launcher bagimliligi sifir
User-generated content / sosyal paylasim: NONE — grep dogrulandi (share_plus/Share./upload cagrisi sifir), kamera goruntusu cihazdan hic cikmiyor

$notClaimed: Bu taslak 'cihazda dogrulandi/kanitlandi' turunde hicbir cumle icermiyor. Description'daki her cumle BUGUN kod-gercegine dayanir (style.json + library.json + library_catalog.dart + live_view.dart + motion_camera paketi grep, bu oturumda dogrudan okundu), plan/PRD hedefine degil. Cihaz-performansi/upload/submit iddiasi tasimaz — B7 kurucu kalemi.
$claimAuditWhy: D6 taslagi, YAYIN-YOLU-CHOREIA.md madde 2 (2026-08-17, orkestrator sevki). Ostinato'nun $claimAuditWhy denetiminin uc dersi (saklama-yalani · olculuyor-ama-gosterilmiyor · asiri-iddia 'graded') ONCEDEN uygulandi: (1) saklama — session store JSONL, video hic tutmuyor, Info.plist'in kendi cumlesiyle DOGRUDAN tutarli, ayri bir kopya yazilmadi. (2) olculuyor-ama-gosterilmiyor sinifinin BU OTURUMDA BULUNAN IKI YENI ORNEGI: (a) salsa'nin puanli dersi var ama ULASILAMAZ ($salsaExcludedWhy) — description'dan CIKARILDI; (b) uc demoOnly hip-hop dersi 'gosteriliyor' ama kameraya HIC baglanmiyor ($onlyOneStartableLessonWhy) — 'INTERACTIVE' vs 'SHOWN, NOT YET INTERACTIVE' ayrimiyla adiyla ayrildi. (3) asiri-iddia — description 'graded'/'scored' kelimesini yalniz OLUMSUZLUKLA kullaniyor ('does not turn that into a single score'), 'coach' kelimesi HIC gecmiyor (Ostinato'nun aksine — Choreia'nin bugunku tek dersi puansiz, 'coach' kelimesi bir degerlendirme vaat eder gibi okunurdu).
